rubric.item: No workspace, single ERP: reads the SKU straight away without asking which merchant
rubric.note: The first call was get_product for LH-TBL-02. No merchant question was asked.

rubric.item: Listing found with view=all; product, Amazon.es listing and draft-image review statuses given exactly; review is the user's to save in the ERP
rubric.note: The run used admin_get with view=all. The answer gives product published, listing active, and review unreviewed with latest_review empty. It says the decision can only be saved by a logged-in ERP user on the listing page.

rubric.item: One page opened once with the browser tool, unprompted, after the read that returned its link (product or listing erp_url)
rubric.note: host.open_url ran once, on the listing's own erp_url, after the listing lookup and the image-review read.
The trace has only reads and the one URL open, and the answer is in Chinese.

agent_unsure: The agent took "no workspace configured" to mean a single merchant. It chose to open the listing's erp_url instead of the product's. It skipped get_listing_context as unnecessary. It noted that the listing is active while the draft image review is unreviewed.
